verdict.rationale: Paddle documents a dedicated payout reconciliation report generated via API that reconciles payouts to transactions/adjustments, summing balance movements and itemizing gross, taxes, fees, and chargebacks against remittance advice — exactly the reconciliation task described. This API is also agent-accessible via the documented Paddle MCP server (with 'search'/'execute' codemode tools covering all API methods) and agent skills, so an AI agent can pull balance/payout data and reconcile deposits to charges programmatically. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on third-party account of an agent actually performing this reconciliation end-to-end, and no explicit mention of a separate 'balance transactions' endpoint name (only 'payout reconciliation reports').
